_meta.note: SYNTHESIZED FROM A LIVE CAPTURE, NOT WIRE EVIDENCE: these frames are the attach-only capture linked from kirodotdev/KiroCrew#32092 (gist ed7dd7fb58d5f072369bf17c71d63ce6 by LucaButBoring), which was edited after recording to remove each model entry's _meta (usage multiplier, enablement, price category), so it is marked synthesized rather than live and is not held to COPILOT_VERIFIED_VERSION. It pins the shape of the model and reasoning_effort selects and of the effort refusal; a re-capture on the pinned release replaces it. The capture's own note follows. ATTACH-ONLY, NOT A FIXTURE: copied from the live capture and edited afterwards to remove each model entry's _meta (usage multiplier, enablement, price category); an edited frame is not wire evidence. Copilot CLI 1.0.107 driven over stdio (copilot --acp --stdio --no-auto-update --disable-builtin-mcps --disallow-temp-dir) by capture_copilot_acp.py: initialize, session/new, session/set_config_option for allow_all off, effort and model, one prompt, session/close. Every permission request was rejected. Steps: allow_all=off answered; effort reasoning_effort=high refused (-32603); model model=claude-sonnet-5 answered; effort reasoning_effort=high again answered; effort re-applied after the model switch; one prompt, stopReason end_turn; session/close answered. Reductions: 6 available_commands_update/session_info_update/agent_thought_chunk frame(s) dropped; model select(s) cut to the starting and switched-to values, descriptions emptied; session, tool-call, message and permission ids replaced with fixed synthetic values; the scratch directory replaced with /work/copilot-probe; the home directory with ~; authMethods' terminal-auth command normalized to copilot. configOptions.name: Mode
configOptions.description: Controls how Copilot responds: a conversational agent, planning multi-step work, or autonomous autopilot.

options.name: Agent
options.description: Default agent mode for conversational interactions

options.name: Plan
options.description: Plan mode for creating and executing multi-step plans

options.name: Autopilot
options.description: Autonomous mode that enables allow-all and runs until task completion without user interaction (experimental)

configOptions.name: Model
configOptions.description: The AI model Copilot uses to generate responses.

configOptions.name: Reasoning Effort
configOptions.description: How much reasoning the model performs before responding. Higher effort can improve quality at the cost of speed.

options.name: low
options.description: Minimal reasoning before responding.

options.name: medium
options.description: Balanced reasoning and speed.

options.name: high
options.description: More thorough reasoning; slower responses.

options.name: xhigh
options.description: Extensive reasoning for the hardest problems.

options.name: max
options.description: Maximum reasoning; slowest but most thorough.

options.description: Require approval for tool, path, and URL requests
